# Aexozone

## About Us
Aexozone is a premier digital agency based in Pune, India. We specialize in web and app development, Enterprise CRM & ERP Systems, Digital & Growth Marketing, and AI-Powered SaaS Architecture.

## Services
- Web & App Development
- Enterprise CRM & ERP Systems
- Digital & Growth Marketing
- AI-Powered SaaS Architecture

## Target Audience
We primarily serve Small Businesses and SaaS companies.

## Unique Selling Points
- One team for video editing, web/app development and branding
- Fixed-price packages with no hidden charges
- First draft delivered within 5 days
- 2 free revision rounds on every project
- SEO and AI-search-ready websites built in from day one
